name: Bell of Recollection: Zhen of Thunder

lines.text: Ah Bai, Ah Lan, do you know where the Waking Bell replacement part is?
Let me think. A senior mentioned it to us before... It's been hidden at a very special place...
Stop thinking and start kicking. We gotta finish the kicking exercise. Old Man Lu said we must kick six slugs into their tunnels or we'll never leave...
Sorry. I gotta complete my exercise... Once I'm done, I'll go look for the replacement part.
